NoticeState.broken: A broken item doesn't work properly (armor: AC penalty, shields: no Shield Block, weapons: unusable). It needs repair.

Dur.Title: Durability
Dur.NoHp: No Hit Points yet — give it its material's.
Dur.GiveHint: Hardness and HP from the GM Core material table (precious materials by grade).
Dur.RepairHint: Repair: Crafting check (DC {dc}). Success +{n} HP, critical +{c} HP, critical failure 2d6 damage. Needs a repair kit.
Dur.Hint: Damage to items is reduced by Hardness. At or below the Broken Threshold (the line) an item is broken, at 0 destroyed (can't be repaired). Click a bar to type its HP. Anyone can Repair (10 minutes) with their own character.
Dur.BarHint: Click and type the Hit Points (Enter saves, Esc cancels)
Dur.MaterialHint: Changing the material sets Hardness/HP/BT to that material's standard values

Upkeep.Title: After the fight
Upkeep.WearSaid: Gear wore down during the fight:
Upkeep.Hint: The party after the fight: HP, conditions, focus points, gear worn this fight. Give everyone XP below.

Craft.Title: Crafting
Craft.NoFormulas: No formulas. You can drop an item here too.
Craft.PickHint: Pick a formula on the left or drop an item here.
Craft.SetupHint: Rules (remaster): {n} day(s) of setup before the check (1 with the formula, 2 without). On a success you pay the raw materials (half the Price); each later day takes this much off. Finish any time by paying the rest.
Craft.FinishHint: Pay what's left and finish now.
Craft.AbandonAsk: Give up this project? Materials already paid are not returned (nothing is paid before the check).
Craft.Drop: Drop an item from a compendium or the sidebar onto this window to craft it.

Need.Level: The item's level ({n}) is above the character's.
Need.Formula: Not in the formula book (GM check).

Craft.Fail: {item}: Crafting check failed — no materials lost. Try again.
Craft.Started: {item}: started — paid {materials} for materials. {per} per day, free in {days} days.
Craft.FinishedPaid: {item} done! Paid the remaining {paid} after {days} days.
Craft.FinishedFree: {item} done! Finished after {days} days of work at no extra cost.
Craft.SetupStarted: {item}: setting up — Crafting check in {days} day(s). Keep {materials} of materials ready (spent only on a success).
Craft.CheckNow: {item}: set up — roll the Crafting check.
Craft.SetupDone: {item}: setup done — roll the Crafting check (DC {dc}) at the workbench.
Craft.EffectSetupDesc: {left} day(s) of setup left · then a Crafting check DC {dc}
Craft.FactsSetup: {n} day(s) of setup left · materials {materials} (paid on success)

Clock.plan: Days of work come from the day planner's Craft hours (Rutz's PF2e Days) — 8 hours = a day.
Clock.time: Every day the world clock moves counts as a day of work.
Clock.manual: Days of work are counted with the +1 day button.

Settings.AutoStatsHint: Weapons and armor a character gains get Hardness and HP from their material (only those without HP).
Settings.BarsHint: An HP bar next to weapons, armor and shields in the inventory; click to open the durability window.
Settings.NoticeHint: Say in chat when an item loses Hit Points.
Settings.BrokenArmorHint: Equipped broken gear puts a 'Broken: …' effect on the character (armor: AC penalty); gone when repaired.
Settings.WearHint: Gear wears down a little in fights.
Settings.WearHardnessHint: Off: wear ignores Hardness (slow wear and tear). On: wear smaller than Hardness is stopped.
Settings.UpkeepHint: When to show the party/XP window after an encounter.
Settings.UpkeepAsk: A button in the GM's chat (recommended)
Settings.DailyRateHint: Multiplies what a day of work takes off (Earn Income table). 2 = twice as fast.
Settings.SetupDaysHint: −1 = by the rules (1 with the formula, 2 without). 0 or more: that many.
Settings.NoticeOwners: the character's players and the GM
Settings.BrokenRuleHint: By the rules a broken item can't be used normally. A house rule may give only a penalty.
Settings.WearModeHint: 'Fight log': armor rolls each time its wearer is hit, a weapon each time it deals damage. No hits, no wear.
Settings.WearTimingHint: 'Live' lets gear break in the middle of a fight.
Settings.WearEnd: at the end of the fight
Settings.WearChanceHint: Rolled (d100) per hit taken (armor) or damage dealt (weapon). Default 5%: six hits in a fight ≈ 26% for one point.
Settings.UpkeepPublicHint: Off: the after-fight summary goes to the GM only.
Settings.CraftClockHint: What moves crafting on by a day.
Settings.ClockAuto: auto (day planner with Rutz's PF2e Days, else the world clock)

Broken.Label: Broken: {name}
Broken.NoteRaw: A broken weapon can't be used for its normal function — by the rules it shouldn't be used until repaired (GM's call).

Desc.armor: Broken armor keeps its item bonus but takes a status penalty to AC (−1 light, −2 medium, −3 heavy).
Desc.weapon: Broken weapon: can't be used normally by the rules; a penalty or clumsy by the setting. Gone when repaired.
